response.rationale: Applicable rules: RET-007 (eligible, priority 10) since days_since_delivery=7 and not final sale; RET-050 (goodwill_grant=True, eligible, priority 50); and RET-051 (fraud_hold=True, ineligible, priority 50). RET-012 and RET-020 do not apply (final_sale is False, defective is null). RET-050 and RET-051 tie at priority 50, the highest applicable priority. A fraud hold blocks returns pending review, which overrides a goodwill exception, so the account is ineligible for a return at this time.
